prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent 2D action RPG boss sprite atlas, EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows (16 equal cells) on a square canvas. Same sleek powerful humanoid battle robot in every cell, steel gray armor with deep crimson red armor panels and bright red eye visor, blade on right forearm and compact machine gun on left forearm. Tall athletic proportions, angular armored knees, narrow mechanical waist, menacing but clean illustrated game style, dark outlines, polished cel shading. All poses face SCREEN RIGHT in a three-quarter side view. Keep identical head/body scale, feet baseline and center within every cell, generous transparent padding so no weapon crosses its cell, no shadows, NO text, NO labels, NO background. Row 1 left to right: neutral standing, walking left leg forward/right arm back, walking passing step, walking right leg forward/left arm back. Row 2: sword windup with blade raised behind shoulder, strong forward horizontal blade slash extended right, sword follow-through low, machinegun aimed right with recoil braced legs. Row 3: crouch charging energy with fists near chest, forward lunging dash low body blade extended, bomb held overhead windup, throw bomb forward follow-through (do not draw loose bombs). Row 4: upright invulnerable guard arms crossed chest, spinning slash torso twisted facing viewer blade to right, spinning slash torso turned away blade to left, magnetic pull both open hands reaching forward. Robot remains full-body visible in ALL 16 cells. Separate readable limbs. No giant effects covering body. True transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: 2D side-scrolling Korean urban sci-fi RPG background atlas. EXACT 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal WIDE panels, no borders or gutters, overall canvas landscape aspect 2:1 (each panel 2:1). Beautiful detailed hand-painted anime game environment at night, dark steel, industrial machines, atmospheric light. No characters, no robots, no UI, no text. Every panel has a CLEAR unobstructed continuous walkable metal pavement across bottom 30 percent, horizon at 65 percent height, camera side-on with slight top-down ground view, suitable for sprites walking horizontally. Top left: abandoned accelerator laboratory, long cyan luminous conduits, coils and concrete catwalk. Top right: weapons assembly factory, suspended mechanical arms, violet machinery and conveyor racks behind open pavement. Bottom left: crimson power reactor hall, tall glowing red turbine cores and dark steel pipes. Bottom right: large ominous boss hangar, gray and red futuristic architecture, huge sealed blast door centered in background, red warning lights, open spacious rectangular metal arena floor across foreground. Maintain same perspective, horizon and ground scale in all four panels. Strong visual differences in lighting, clear playable floor, crisp professional game concept art.
